newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-BLUES GET PELUSO FROM DEVILS.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-BLUES GET PELUSO FROM DEVILS.

text.p: The St. Louis Blues acquired rugged left wing Mike Peluso from the New Jersey Devils on Tuesday.
Peluso, one of the league's premier pugilists, played for Blues' coach and general manager, Mike Keenan, when they were with the Chicago Blackhawks.
Peluso, a part of New Jersey's 1995 Stanley Cup winner, was dealt with defenceman Ricard Persson for defenceman Ken Sutton and the Blues' second-round draft choice in 1999.
Peluso, 31, had two assists in 20 games for the Devils this season. In 391 career games, Peluso has 36 goals, 49 assists and 85 points with 1,680 penalty minutes, including 68 this season.
Despite his toughness, Peluso might best be remembered as the player crying on the bench in the final minutes of the clinching game of the Stanley Cup
